document.title: Notice to Shareholder of Undistributed Long-Term Capital Gains
document.issued_by: regulated investment company (RIC) or real estate investment trust (REIT)

boxes.label: Total undistributed long-term capital gains
boxes.notes: 'This amount is your total undistributed long-term capital gain from your regulated investment company (RIC) or real estate investment trust (REIT).' Boxes 1b, 1c and 1d are breakouts already inside it.

boxes.label: Unrecaptured section 1250 gain
boxes.notes: COMPONENT OF BOX 1a. The 2021 instruction says 'Individual filers report this amount on line 11 of the Unrecaptured Section 1250 Gain Worksheet in the Schedule D (Form 1040) instructions for 2021 or the applicable line of the worksheet in the instructions for the current year' - the worksheet line number for 2025 was NOT verified here. Destination is a Schedule D worksheet, outside this scope.

boxes.label: Section 1202 gain
boxes.notes: COMPONENT OF BOX 1a. 'This amount applies to the portion of the amount in box 1a attributable to a section 1202 gain (sale of qualified small business stock).' Destination is the Schedule D QSB exclusion treatment, outside this scope.

boxes.label: Collectibles (28%) gain
boxes.notes: COMPONENT OF BOX 1a. 'This amount is the collectibles gain (28% rate gain) portion of the amount in box 1a.' The 2021 instruction names line 4 of the 28% Rate Gain Worksheet 'for 2021 or the applicable line ... for the current year'; the 2025 line was NOT verified here.

boxes.label: Tax paid by the RIC or REIT on the box 1a gains
boxes.notes: A CREDIT, not income. 'This amount is the tax paid by the RIC or REIT on the undistributed long-term capital gains shown in box 1a. You can apply for a refund or credit of this tax.'

boxes.label: CORRECTED
boxes.notes: FR-016 mark. Printed above the issuer's block on every copy. A corrected form replaces one furnished earlier; its figures are the ones to use, never counted beside the earlier form's.

boxes.label: VOID
boxes.notes: FR-016 mark. Printed on Copy A (the issuer's filing copy) and the state copy; the recipient's Copy B does not print it.

document.notes: Continuous-use form. The revision in force is Rev. November 2021 and there is no 2025 revision: https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/f2439.pdf and https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-prior/f2439--2021.pdf are byte-identical (md5 f6e7f2b997b1ec4f170c3b79a7d4cd34), which is the cleanest possible confirmation. The form reports gains the fund never distributed: the shareholder reports the gain AND takes credit for the tax the fund already paid on it, and increases basis by the difference. Its own instructions name prior-year line numbers ('of the 2021 form or the applicable line on the current year form'), so every destination it names must be re-read against the current year's forms - which is what was done here for Schedule D line 11 and Schedule 3 line 13a.

face_not_boxes.because: 'For calendar year 20__' and 'beginning ..., 20__' are the RIC's or REIT's tax-year blanks, not a box.

extraction.note: Azure ships no prebuilt-tax model for this form, so it reached the generic reader — which emits no field bearing these box names, so every cited route out of this document was dead while looking implemented (spec 075 US1/W42). Read by the declared custom model over the boxes this document declares.

custom.reads: a Form 2439, Notice to Shareholder of Undistributed Long-Term Capital Gains.
